supersedes.reason: Independent exact-head review found that v2 could classify any single ValueError or assertion failure in the baseline property as a reproduced bug. V2 raw artifacts remain unchanged; v3 requires the first registration to succeed and the exact expected conflict on the second call, and includes an unrelated first-call ValueError control.

hypothesis: Calling the pinned upstream _register_module_fusion implementation twice for the same model type, fusion, and source patterns succeeds once and then raises the exact conversion-mapping conflict at baseline; the pinned fix is idempotent, preserves unrelated mappings, and rejects unrelated conflicts.
cheaper_alternative_considered: The v2 raw output contains the expected baseline error text, but its classifier did not enforce that text or call order. A fresh prospective replay with an exact second-call assertion and a first-call fault control is the minimum check that closes the review finding without interpreting v2 as authoritative.

primary_decision_rule: Accept the source-level reproduction only if the baseline and fixed cases produce their exact frozen classifications, the first-call error control is rejected, all three mutants fail on their specific expected properties, all immutable source and executed-module hashes match, and all cases stay within frozen limits. Any mismatch, timeout, OOM, or import failure stops the replay and is retained; no retry is authorized by this protocol.
stopping_rule: Run each of the six cases once in a fresh network-disabled container, sequentially. Stop after six cases or immediately after the first infrastructure, provenance, or resource failure. Do not modify this protocol in response to outcomes.
resource_measurements: host swap snapshots before and after each case

reproduction.source_acquisition: From an immutable Transformers clone, export only src/transformers/fusion_mapping.py with git show for each exact revision and verify its SHA-256 against this protocol before each run.
reproduction.per_case_command_template: docker --context colima run --rm --network none --cpus 1 --memory 536870912 --pids-limit 64 -v <source-dir>:/source:ro -v <probe-path>:/probe.py:ro --entrypoint python vare-transformers-cpu:qualification-v1 /probe.py --case <case> --source /source/fusion_mapping.py --expected-source-sha256 <sha256>
reproduction.host_timeout: Apply a 30-second host timeout to each docker run invocation.
reproduction.raw_output: Retain each command line, stdout, stderr, exit status, start/end timestamps, and host swap snapshot under results/transformers-49412-source-replay-v3/raw/.
